Analysis: Hypothesis 1 presents a more novel and detailed mechanistic model by integrating not only the p62/Keap1/Nrf2 axis but also additional signaling nodes (such as mTOR activation and inflammatory cytokines) that expand our understanding of the transition from alcohol-induced hepatic cytoprotection to oncogenic transformation. This multi-layered approach enhances its plausibility and testability, as specific pathways and temporal dynamics are clearly outlined, making it easier to design targeted experiments. In contrast, Hypothesis 2, although plausible in the NAFLD context, offers a more linear and less nuanced explanation with insufficient mechanistic detail regarding metabolic reprogramming, reducing its overall novelty and depth. Both hypotheses are safe from an experimental perspective, but the comprehensive scope of Hypothesis 1 makes it superior overall.
